paragraphs: Buddi supplies electronic monitoring tags and software to criminal justice agencies, with solutions developed alongside police, prisons, probation and local government authorities. The company says its offender monitoring supports supervision, rehabilitation and the protection of local communities.

The system pairs a web-based monitoring platform called Eagle with modular hardware in the Buddi Smart Tag family. AlcoTag puts alcohol monitoring and GPS tracking in a single compact device. A radio frequency product handles curfew compliance in real time. There is also a domestic abuse monitoring product sold to authorities. Field staff work through Eagle Mobile and Eagle Installer on Android and iOS devices.

Buddi was founded in 2004. It reports over 250 clients globally, with products designed and manufactured in the UK. Customers are listed throughout Europe, the United States of America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. The company operates as a brand within Big Technologies Group plc. Its history page records a flotation on the London Stock Exchange's AIM market under the ticker AIM:BIG.

quote.text: Electronic monitoring facilitates the shift from incarceration to rehabilitative community based sentencing.
